title: Establishing Boundary KKT Convergence of Mirror Descent through Reparameterization
summary: Sequence convergence to a boundary Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) point has long remained unclear for nonconvex mirror descent with Legendre kernels. The difficulty arises from the blow-up of the gradient of the Legendre kernel at the boundary. Recent work~\cite{dingtoh2026nonkkt} shows that mirror descent can accumulate at non-KKT boundary points despite decreasing objective values, precluding a convergence guarantee to KKT points in general.
